description: Opt-in publish manifest for the /reports route. Every entry here is rendered/served publicly by scripts/build-reports.mjs; anything not listed does not ship. Sources must already be sanitized summaries — no raw traces, run JSON, transcripts, or lab session dumps. Provenance is metadata only: run ids and campaign ids, never links into docs/prds/.

reports.title: Concierge adversarial probe report
reports.summary: 10 adversarial probes against production and staging: the concierge guardrail held 10/10 on both surfaces, and a deliberately-broken control scored 3/3 broke, proving the judge discriminates.

reports.title: Widget-adapter sunset assessment

reports.title: Full repository code review
